discussion.body: SET-1.1 Chrome and contracts — impl status: built, not done (waiting design verify). Named regions data-ui, tokens, hidden docks for Grok/presence/layers/style mounted, dev mode and flag panel with descriptions, inspector shell. Exit (select a frame, inspector says it is selected, hidden docks exist, flags flip without a layout rewrite) is true in the running app. FEAT-020 slots are now populated because SET-1.2 filled values; the shell itself shipped in 1.1. How to verify: select a frame, confirm inspector, open hidden docks in the tree, toggle a flag.
